hooks.name: server_packets
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge has no packet counting event; PacketEvents' PacketSendEvent and PacketReceiveEvent)

rust_summary: each player's play packets once a tick, by id and body bytes, sent and received (`native_server_packets`), while a mod counts them (`native_count_packets`).
doc_summary: `native_server_packets(player, packets, outbound)`, once a tick per player and way, each packet as (id, body bytes), while `native_count_packets(true)` is on (off, nothing is kept). Bundles need "hooks": @API:server_packets@.
